title: Continuous sizing of the v8 altcoin-kimchi signal (replaces the threshold rule)
rule: same Gen247 z per altcoin; weight = 0.1 x clip(z / 2, -1, 1) (full size at |z| >= 2, half at |z| = 1, small near 0); next day; perps 5 bp + funding. Replaces v8.1's threshold alt-kimchi sleeve
why: a threshold throws away the size of the signal; proportional sizing is the standard alternative (no parameter chosen from results: the scale 2 is fixed so that the old threshold point z = 1 gets half size)
